until.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when the pause ends by itself. null: until the control plane clears it. A time already past is accepted and simply inactive. Required key.

reason.description: Why, 1 to 200 bytes, shown verbatim in health, doctor, the heartbeat and the jobs.paused webhook (for example show: fight night 12).

retention_hours.description: Counted from REGISTRATION, not from finalize. An unregistered artifact is never swept (final plan 11.17).

destination.description: An absolute directory, or null for the node default. Never set together with destination_ref.

destination_ref.description: A storage.destinations name, or null for the node default. Never set together with destination.

url.description: srt://, rtmp://, or rtmps://. Those three schemes are the whole set.

revision.description: Monotonic, 1 or above (0 is the node's 'nothing applied'). The node applies one revision transactionally and reports it back in desired_revision_applied.

streams.description: FULL replacement for the fleet-owned stream set. Empty means the fleet owns no streams here; it does not mean unchanged.

revocations.description: FULL replacement for the revocation list. Required array: always serialises as [] (empty array), never null. A partial revocation list is worse than none, so the fleet sends [] to clear it.

open_posture.description: Whether this node accepts a validly signed key for a stream it has never seen.

jobs_pause.description: The told jobs pause: the node claims no new transcode job until it ends, running jobs finish, queued jobs wait. FULL replacement: null or absent clears a pause the fleet set (and an API pause the box held when it joined). Optional: a control plane that predates it sends none, which reads as no fleet pause. The pause belongs to this enrollment and ends with it.

min_key_epoch.description: Reject keys below this epoch. It applies to the next handshake and never disconnects an attached publisher.

labels.description: Opaque, echoed in every webhook for this stream. The node never interprets them.

lease.description: The told grant of this stream's live output prefix, or null when the fleet does not manage it. Optional: absent is null, so a control plane that predates it changes nothing.

heartbeat_url.description: The FULL heartbeat endpoint. The node never appends to it and never follows a redirect away from it.

node_id.description: Durable identity, assigned by the control plane and stable across reinstalls.

node_name.description: The name the fleet knows this box by. It may differ from the requested name; the node adopts this one.

fleet_token.description: The long-term bearer token. The node keeps it inside /etc/tmesis/fleet.json (mode 0640, root:tmesis) beside the enrollment it belongs to, so identity and credential are written by one atomic rename (D11). It is never written into config.yml or .env.

epoch.description: The fencing epoch the control plane granted, 1 or above. Its own domain, never the node's local lease epoch.

holder.description: The fleet node id (enroll response node_id) that holds the prefix at this epoch. Any other node writes nothing to the prefix.
